name: electrician-route-checker
description: Plan your UK electrician training and qualification route

interface.longDescription: Understand UK electrician training routes based on your current experience and qualifications. Electrician Route Checker explains Level 2, Level 3, 18th Edition, workplace-based Level 3 NVQ progression, external AM2 and appropriate ECS Gold Card eligibility. This provides high-level educational guidance, mainly for the adult installation pathway in England; requirements can differ by UK nation and occupation. It does not assess competence or confirm qualification/card eligibility.
defaultPrompt: How do I become an electrician in the UK as an adult?
I've completed Level 3 electrical training. What should I do next?
How can I complete an electrical NVQ if I don't have suitable workplace experience?

positive.prompt: I'm 35, have no electrical qualifications and want to become an electrician. Where do I start?
positive.expected_behavior: Recognise a complete beginner, explain Level 2 and the high-level adult route, and distinguish technical training from workplace competence.

positive.prompt: I've finished Level 2 Electrical Installation. What comes next?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain suitable Level 3, 18th Edition if needed, workplace/NVQ progression, external AM2 and conditional ECS card eligibility.

positive.prompt: I've completed Level 3 but I don't have electrical site experience. What should I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Clarify the exact Level 3 award, explain technical study alone is insufficient, suitable real work, NVQ competence progression and the limited Elec Training placement guarantee with separate support charges.

positive.prompt: Can I become an electrician without doing an apprenticeship?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer yes, explain the adult non-apprenticeship route, workplace competence, later NVQ, external AM2 and ECS progression; do not declare one route universally best.

positive.prompt: I'm already working as an electrician's mate. Can my work help with an NVQ?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain that job title alone is insufficient; actual tasks, supervision, evidence breadth and assessor requirements determine suitability.

negative.description: No automatic qualification from technical Level 3
negative.prompt: I've completed Level 3. Am I automatically a fully qualified electrician now?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer no. Level 3 technical/classroom study alone does not demonstrate full occupational competence.

negative.prompt: Does Elec Training give every student a guaranteed paid job?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer no. Restrict the paid placement guarantee to Level 3 NVQ learners who need workplace experience to complete their qualification. Do not include separately charged placement support in the base fee.

negative.prompt: Can I take my AM2 at Elec Training?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer no. Elec Training does not deliver AM2; it is external at an approved NET assessment centre.

review.commerce_description: The tools provide educational information only. They do not sell products, accept payments, collect leads or submit forms. Optional relevant external route-checker links are not required to use the tools.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only release with four educational tools for likely electrician routes, qualification stages, NVQ workplace progression and route comparison. No login, contact collection, payments or form submissions.
